synthesis.body: On an unmerged (UU) path the three obvious escapes behave differently: 'git stash' fails with '<file>: needs merge', plain 'git commit' refuses with 'Committing is not possible because you have unmerged files', but 'git commit -a' SUCCEEDS — its implicit 'git add -u' marks the conflict resolved and commits the file with '<<<<<<<' intact. Any tooling or guidance that offers commit as the safe alternative to stash must special-case the unmerged branch, or it hands the agent a one-step path to committing conflict markers. Verified on git 2.50.1.

title: 'git commit -a' commits conflict markers; 'git stash' and plain 'git commit' refuse
